_about: Golden reference charts for BornClock. Generated by scripts/golden/generate_golden.py from the Swiss Ephemeris and hand-recorded AstroSage values — never from BornClock code. Do not edit by hand; re-run the generator. Each chart lists the source of every expected field in "refs" (keys of "sources").

sources.PANEL: Standard 10-person audit panel (Round 2 audit, scratchpad round2/CONTEXT.md, 17 Oct 2026).
sources.EDGE_BIRTHS: Edge-case births chosen for this suite (Oct 2026); boundary times found by scanning the Swiss Ephemeris. Margins to the nearest boundary are in swiss.margins.
sources.COUPLE_BIRTHS: Extra births used in the AstroSage couples (Round 2 audit probe round2/M/run3.mts).
sources.IANA: Local time → UTC via the IANA tz database (Python zoneinfo), e.g. Asia/Kolkata 1942–45 = UTC+6:30, Europe/London 1968–71 = UTC+1.
sources.SWISS: Swiss Ephemeris (pyswisseph 2.10.03, swe.calc_ut apparent geocentric positions; Ascendant from swe.houses_ex). Sidereal = tropical − (SIDM_LAHIRI mean ayanamsa, FLG_NONUT, + 24.4″), the Drik Panchang calibration BornClock uses (src/lib/vedic/__tests__/ayanamsaDrik.test.ts). Rahu = mean node, Ketu = Rahu + 180°. Whole-sign houses.
sources.D9_RULE: Navamsa (D9): sign = floor(sidereal longitude / 3°20′) mod 12 (BPHS Ch. 6; same as Drik/AstroSage).
sources.VIMSHOTTARI: Vimshottari Dasha (BPHS Ch. 46): balance from the Moon's position in its nakshatra; periods Ke7 Ve20 Su6 Mo10 Ma7 Ra18 Ju16 Sa19 Me17; antardasha = MD years × AD years / 120; year = 365.25 days (the year length BornClock uses; AstroSage per-chart dasha dates were not recorded, so these dates are Swiss-derived only).
sources.MANGLIK_RULE: Manglik, AstroSage convention (founder decision Oct 2026): Mars in whole-sign house 1, 4, 7, 8 or 12 from the Lagna and, separately, from the Moon; both = High, one = Low, none = None. Cancellations are not applied to the level (AstroSage does not).
sources.ASTROSAGE_2026_10_17: Entered by hand on astrosage.com on 17 Oct 2026 and recorded in the Round 2 audit (scratchpad round2.txt, "Matching and Manglik vs AstroSage").
sources.KAAL_SARP_RULE: Full Kaal Sarp only (founder decision Oct 2026): all seven planets Sun–Saturn strictly between Rahu and Ketu by longitude, on one side. Partial patterns are not "present".
sources.SADE_SATI_RULE: Sade Sati = Saturn transiting the 12th, 1st or 2nd sign from the natal Moon sign (Rising / Peak / Setting). Cycles = first entry to final exit; gaps under 3 years (retrograde loops) are pauses inside one cycle. Saturn ingress moments from the Swiss Ephemeris (saturnIngresses).
sources.PANCHANG_TESTS: Panchang and festival dates are checked against Drik Panchang in the existing suites listed in panchangReferences (values fetched from drikpanchang.com, cited in each file).
